facts.official_warnings: Check your official weather warnings — Groundtruth never replaces them.
scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.
Thunderstorms are not checked. Storms are a major cause of weather deaths — follow official storm warnings.
The history data is a ~25 km grid and misses very local storms.
Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only. For landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.

reply.headline: Extreme risk of heavy rain in Paiporta, Valencia, Spain on 29 Oct 2024.
why: Rain over 24 hours set the level, at 202 mm, which is at or above the 150 mm danger line.
A day with this much rain was not seen in 1951–1980 or in the 30 years before this date.
Rain over the last 6 days also set the level: the total of 257 mm includes 54.9 mm over the 5 days before, measured, plus the forecast for the day itself.
reply.what_it_means: Avoid underpasses, low roads and riverbanks. Heavy rain like this can flood streets and rivers quickly, so plan around it today. Check your official weather warnings, because Groundtruth never replaces them.
reply.sms: Groundtruth: Extreme risk of heavy rain in Paiporta, Valencia, Spain on 29 Oct 2024. Avoid underpasses, low roads, riverbanks. Check official warnings.
reply.confidence_note: The history is a grid of about 25 km and misses very local storms, and thunderstorms are not checked. The 6-day rain total uses measured rain for the earlier days and the forecast for the day itself; for landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.
